item.title: Orb 0.1.0-beta.4
item.description: Anonymous install counting. Once a day, Orb now sends a random ID for this copy, its version, and your macOS version, so we can see how many people use it. It never sends recordings, transcripts, or anything on your screen. You can turn it off in Settings → Privacy, which also deletes the ID.

item.title: Orb 0.1.0-beta.3
item.description:
First beta of Orb: show your agent what you mean.

  • Record and talk. Press the shortcut, walk through your screen, and say what you're thinking. Orb transcribes on your Mac and gives the recording a title.
  • Hand it to your agent. Click Copy agent prompt and paste it into Claude Code, Codex or any agent with a terminal. It gets your narration, screenshots and which apps you were in.
  • Interactive mode (experimental). A GPT-Live voice thought partner that talks back while you record and can point at things on your screen. It needs your own OpenAI API key, and while it's on, your audio goes to OpenAI.

Before you start: Orb needs macOS 26 on an Apple Silicon Mac. Summaries and titles use Apple Intelligence. The first time you press Record, macOS asks for Screen Recording permission: turn Orb on in System Settings, then quit and reopen Orb. Cloud share links are coming soon. Orb updates itself when new betas come out.
